subject: SpectraWorks trial — PO exemption & onboarding checklist
body:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@spectraworks.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@spectraworks.ai
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick start request — trial invoice & PO exemption

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to spin up a 30-day trial of Redwood for a pilot workload next Monday, but our procurement team is slow to issue a PO (they require a vendor intake that can take 2–3 weeks). For the trial (estimated spend <$1,500) we wanted to request a temporary no-PO path so we can start immediately and route a single invoice at the end of the month.

Attached: SpectraWorks_Trial_Invoice.pdf (PDF, 36KB)
Attached: SpectraWorks_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (Excel, 12KB)

Questions:
- Is Redwood able to accept a one-off invoice without a PO for pilot customers?
- If an exception is possible, what approvals/evidence are required on our side?

Appreciate any guidance — we want to avoid blocking the pilot.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform, SpectraWorks
liam@spectraworks.ai

----

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@spectraworks.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick start request — trial invoice & PO exemption

Hi Liam —

Short answer: yes, we can often make a temporary exception for small pilots, but we need a few items from procurement + a quick internal approval (finance + sales). I'm looping in our procurement lead (Laura) and Sales Ops (Marissa) to confirm what we need and to expedite.

Next steps from our side:
- Laura: confirm evidence checklist and any limits
- Marissa: I'll coordinate the mutual action plan and signoff

I'll follow up with a concrete list in the next 24 hours.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com

----

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick start request — trial invoice & PO exemption

Laura/Marissa — forwarding SpectraWorks' request. Small pilot (<$1.5k). Liam included an invoice + onboarding form. Can procurement approve a temporary no-PO invoice route? If yes, what evidence do you need from the customer (insurance/W9/authorized signer)? Also, any spending cap or duration limit we should impose?

David — can legal sign off on a short payment addendum if procurement requires it?

Thanks,
Rachel

----

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick start request — trial invoice & PO exemption

Team —

We can approve a temporary invoice-only path for trials under $2,000 with these controls:
- Evidence: completed onboarding form, W-9 (or foreign equivalent), invoice to be routed to billing@redwoodinference.com
- Limit: single invoice covering the pilot; no auto-renew or subscription activation without a PO
- Duration: exception valid for up to 45 days from start date
- Approvals: Finance (Laura) + Sales Manager (Rachel) signoff; Procurement documents in Confluence updated

If legal requires any wording, David can propose a one-paragraph payment addendum. Once we have the W-9 and onboarding form, I'll mark SpectraWorks as "Trial - Invoice-only" in the vendor tracker and route the invoice upon receipt.

Marissa — please ensure the M.A.P. has clear milestones and a cancellation clause to prevent accidental auto-billing.

I'll approve this internally pending the requested docs.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Ops, Redwood Inference

----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick start request — trial invoice & PO exemption

Thanks — happy to own MAP updates. Rachel, I'll add a short section that calls out "Trial — invoice only, single invoice, no renewal". Liam, I'll send a DocuSign addendum that locks the trial terms.

Related links:
- HubSpot company: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
- Draft DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/embedded/sign?doc=abc123

I'll send the DocuSign this afternoon. Once we have W-9 + onboarding form and the signed addendum, finance will accept the invoice.

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

----

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@spectraworks.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick start request — trial invoice & PO exemption

Hi Liam —

Quick update and approval path:

On Wed, Jun 9, 2027 at 09:30 Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Team —
>
> We can approve a temporary invoice-only path for trials under $2,000 with these controls:
> - Evidence: completed onboarding form, W-9, invoice to billing@redwoodinference.com
> - Limit: single invoice; no auto-renew
> - Duration: 45 days

So we can proceed. Action items for SpectraWorks:
1) Return the completed onboarding form (attached earlier) + W-9 to billing@redwoodinference.com
2) Sign the DocuSign trial addendum Marissa will send (covers single-invoice, no renewal)
3) Confirm pilot start date (we'll mark the 45-day exception window)

Marissa will send the DocuSign link in a separate email. Once signed and we have the W-9, finance will accept the one-off invoice.

If anything changes, loop in procurement but this is green to start.

Thanks — excited to get the pilot running.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

(Attachment stubs referenced: W-9 pending; DocuSign link)
